label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Home page: the Cart link has no visible count name and an unnamed checkbox sits in the header; several header links (icon-only) have no accessible name, so I could not tell what they do
Many links in the home page and footer contain only an image and have no name, so they cannot be targeted or understood (product image links, social icons)
Product page has an unnamed combobox next to the add to cart button; I could not tell what it selects (size/colour/quantity), and the cart later showed Size: S, Color: Gray that I never chose
Cart quantity combobox has no accessible name, and after adding the item the cart link in the header is just named 1 with no explanation
Checkout login page has two textboxes both named Email: (login and guest), so I had to use an index to pick the guest one; the two forms are not grouped with labels
Page title stays the generic Solidus - Sample Store on login, address, delivery and payment steps, so the current checkout step is not announced; the step list shows no current-step marker

events.thought: Payment step reached, stopping without paying

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Home page: the Cart link has no visible count name and an unnamed checkbox sits in the header; several header links (icon-only) have no accessible name, so I could not tell what they do
Many links in the home page and footer contain only an image and have no name, so they cannot be targeted or understood (product image links, social icons)
Product page has an unnamed combobox next to the add to cart button; I could not tell what it selects (size/colour/quantity), and the cart later showed Size: S, Color: Gray that I never chose
Cart quantity combobox has no accessible name, and after adding the item the cart link in the header is just named 1 with no explanation
Checkout login page has two textboxes both named Email: (login and guest), so I had to use an index to pick the guest one; the two forms are not grouped with labels
Page title stays the generic Solidus - Sample Store on login, address, delivery and payment steps, so the current checkout step is not announced; the step list shows no current-step marker
